notes.title: Terrordrome Reign of the Legends Development Update: September 2025
notes.notes:
Summer is starting to fade with Halloween appearing in a months time.
Here's this months development update.

We're back from EVO


[previewyoutube="CG36wE4AAm8;full"][/previewyoutube]


As you can see we enjoyed EVO immensely and we had so much positive reactions and feedback from players at the event.
The players that have attended and talked with us during the teams time in Vegas overall really enjoyed the game so far and we greatly appreciate the time they took playing the game and making suggestions on what we can add more of.
We'd also like to thank Mr MKL the organiser for this years indie showcase again as it wouldn't be possible for people to discover the game in person without them.
Will we be at EVO 2026?



Patch 1.04 is on the way

Now that EVO is over we can get back into developing the game further and providing more quality of life features as well a gigantic amount of bug fixes coming down the road and we mean a lot but here's some adjustments we're proud to show you today.



New scroll wheel for both players (Requested by EVO player)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/e89769e9d1c44232afd91b8f24ead861d6def32b.png"]A good idea from a resident at EVO requesting both players to have their own scroll wheel so each player can view each characters moves freely, which we was able to add to the game.



Rendering buffs and fixes. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/9050b63807029689f4d1a99e49f6b9c4207b81cc.jpg"]Lots of work has been added here as players have been experiencing graphical errors with the last patch and with this one they should be now fixed and sharper than ever. That being said some players have requested a feature to turn off outlines, although we are unable to add such a feature we decided for those using the ultra setting the outlines will be minuscule and barely visible.  Thank you for reading and see you in October. The Terrordrome Team.

notes.title: Terrordrome Reign of the Legends development update: August 2025
notes.notes:

This will help players understand how in depth our combo system really is and will vary in difficulty from easiest to hardest.
There will be multiple combos to learn and is available for every character on the roster, be sure to check it out.

We are also planning on other modes that we would like to come to fruition in the future.





We are at EVO Right Now!

We have enjoyed our time at EVO last year and it's a privilege to be here again this year and we thank the event organisers for helping with the setting our official EVO debut thank you.

notes.title: Terrordrome Reign of the Legends development update: June 2025
notes.notes:
Beating off the rays of the sun at the start of June, developing more as we continue our way to Las Vegas.

A live stream is on the way
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/8de243a9ed2d3af5fd85955dd3cf9b9cd2fa0a70.png
We can confirm that this month that we will be doing a special live stream with a special announcement in regards to EVO.
This stream will go over lots of stuff we have been working on behind the scenes and other exciting information.
We haven't given out a date that the stream will take place so be sure to stay up to date on our discord and other social media platforms for more information.

Combo Trials
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/e9e22c165953d131c347a5e39492792c928aaba0.png

Combo Trials has been finished! and will be on it's way to public access in a future giga patch we plan to release.
Combo Trials is a mode for those who want to lab and explore what Reign of the Legends is truly capable of, combo trials can be played with any of the characters on the roster with multiple combos from easy to hard to learn.

3 secret characters development
2 of the 3 characters are in the integration phase of development, character 3 has some animations in the works as well as the voice for character 3 has now been recorded by none other than Sasquatch voice actor Brian Watts.
We're currently in search of actors for the other 2 characters.

That's all we can share this month, remember to check out our socials for the live stream and the team will give out another update in July and head our way to EVO after.

notes.title: Terrordrome Reign of the Legends development update: May 2025
notes.notes:
It's May day and the sun has awoken as we develop the game wearing sunglasses deflecting the light from the window.
Here is this months development update for Terrordrome ROTL.

Update on combo trials mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/a766bd09af1b372bad19679a90d98f8f3514546d.png

The combo trails for all characters are finished as well as the UI for it!
Before we decide to release we are in the play testing and bug finding phase of development.
Once we are happy with the mode we plan to release it with a patch sometime before EVO and move towards the implementation of 2 of the now 4 free DLC playable characters.

Developement of the Free DLC characters

As mentioned above, once we finish the combo trials mode we will be implementing 2 of the 4 DLC characters to the games engine which means that yes the animations for all of their moves have already been completed, the 3rd character has some animations finished and some moves that are in need to be animated, the 4th character only has the model made for the time being.
We will likely announce who these characters are much later when we're ready to release.

EVO
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/8de243a9ed2d3af5fd85955dd3cf9b9cd2fa0a70.png

We will be at EVO again, as for which location we will be at, we will disclose that at a later date so be sure to keep a heads up with our announcements as well as EVO's themselves for more infomation.

That's all we could share this month, and we'll be sure to continue our work leading up to the journey to EVO Las Vagas.

notes.title: Terrordrome Reign of the Legends Development Update: April 2025
notes.notes:
Lots of work behind the scenes which we can now announce what we've been up to today.

Spring is here as we dig our heels deeper into development like our name was Jack.
We have a new mode on the way soon as well as other info we would like to present.

Update on visual changes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/436ebbec068c96fbee46aad34354f27b92d61717.png
In the last development update we mentioned that we wanted to go through a visual overhaul that will make the game look more akin to a horror comic rather than what we had before.
Due to multiple factors we have decided to meet the two styles halfway keeping the more realistic textures and lighting whilst combined with our outline shader in order to help differentiate the character from the stage, in addition we have found that the add on of outlines have helped players who have some minor visual impairment issues see the character easier so we have decided to keep the shader for the foreseeable future.

Combo Trials is on the way!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/e9e22c165953d131c347a5e39492792c928aaba0.png
This has been in development before but back when we did, we were still working out the games combat mechanics and since the game is out it is back in development and close to begin finished.
At the time of this post 8 characters have their own combo trails implemented already which means there's only 4 more characters left to go before we release this new mode to the public.
Please note that the moves displayed within the UI will be updated and renamed before release.

thank you for reading the development update and we'll see you again next month.

notes.title: Terrordrome Reign of the Legends Development Update: January 2025
notes.notes:
2024 has been a big year for us as we finally shipped 1.0 of Terrordrome Reign of the Legends.
A year may stop but we don't.
Happy New Year and here's the first development update of 2025!

NEW visual outline shaders!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/158ce7ceec6671e48c892ba36e15e238a521a830.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/0060c84315be1398ce254d29de9c0918cef4ed41.png
We are changing how the game looks.
Realistic rendering technology for the game has been a bit of a struggle for us so we took alternative routes into our game and as some who have played the recent update have noticed we have added a shader that outlines our characters to give them a bit more of a fresh POP!
Not only does it look better than before but it brings more visual diversity to the game and helps the characters stand out from the stages a little more than before.
Seeing how much of an improvement this small addition made, we have been experimenting more of what we could do to make ROTL have that visual burst of energy as well as keeping to our horror themes.
We're looking more into a possible shaded arty look to make the game have a more horror comic looking feel as we have decided to produce the story of the game through comic form.

Alt costumes update
So far we have now rigged up 4 of the 12 character alts which means we are already a third of the way through the roster and we are getting these done quicker than we thought we would of but there's still more to do.

2025 and comics
As mentioned above we will be moving the story towards more of a comic than a mode as it was more preferred through our polls and this year we are gonna take steps into working on that including fitting the game with a new comic look which will take time.
2024 was only the start and here's to another year of improvements, fixes and a even greater game.

notes.title: Terrordrome : Reign Of The Legends - 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Varies fixes to most Visual FX within Death Sentences, fix for Death Sentences causing soft locks and more.

 Note : Publishing reviews talking about bugs without properly reporting them is bad matters,  if you find a bug REPORT IT so we all benefit from the fix!! 

 Achievement Changes and Additions 

[olist]
 Removed an exploit for the Combo Damage Achievement, if you have already unlocked this achievement than no issue. But if you want to reset this achievement in order to unlocked it the intended way you can follow these steps.

[olist]
 Right Click the Start Button and Select Run

 Then type "steam://open/console" without quotes press enter. Within Steam you'll have a new Console tab.

 within the Steam Console paste this without the quotes "achievement_clear 1291170 COMBO_DAMAGE_50" then press enter. 
[/olist]

 A new Achievement has been added to the game based off of a special win pose from the Lady In White

[/olist]

 Changes / Fixes 

[olist]

 The game no longer waits on the initial loading screen till your fully logged in, this login process in most cases finishes before reaching the Press Any Button Screen. This will improve loading when starting the game.

 Adjusted certain sounds on characters that may have been too loud, we're still investigating if more sounds need to be adjusted.

 Fixed an issue that wouldn't allow a character to drop to 0 health in certain Death Sentences.

 Fixed varies Visual FX that wasn't showing up properly on screen.

 Fixed an issue not allow Sasquatch to fully turn invisible when performing this move.

 Fixed an issue that would show Isadora for a few frames still she fully spawns from the Sky. (Dracula's Helper Call)

 When Guard All is set within Opponent options they will properly switch to crouch state when the player does a move while crouching.

 Fixed an issue on the Character move list that would sometimes cause the Kick button to be placed in the wrong order within certain Combo Strings.

 Reenabled Lady In White's Random Win Pose (Jump Scare).

 Fixed an issue that wouldn't switch to a crouch state when attempting to block a low attack when you have previously blocked a high/overhead attack.

 Fixed an issue causing Wendigo's EX Turn Pike to use two meter stocks while in the corner.

 Fixed an issue causing the health of both characters being reduced to 1 when Player 1 or Player 2 gauge fill within training mode was set to Normal mode.

 Fixed an issue that would reset the button press within the Jump or Crouch within Opponent options in Training mode.

 Adjusted the lighting and position for the selected character within the Online Lobby.

[/olist]

 Localization Changes 

[olist]

 Fixed an issue that wouldn't properly save the Selected Language within the game, you'll need to reselect your native language within the settings.

 Changed instances within certain language where Round is used and replaced with Chapter to match the announcers.

[/olist]

notes.title: Terrordrome Reign of the Legends Development Update: November 2024
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to the first development update since 1.0 release.
We have finally officially launched the game but this is only the beginning as we have lots if things to do to move forward and we're delighted to share our next steps with you today!

Beast Dracula Confirmed boss and playable character!
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GbPJ-KxacAI-4s_.jpg:large

We can finally announce that yes the final boss will be a beastly version of Dracula which we have kept secret for a very long time, we can also confirm that he'll be joining the game along with the other 3 secret characters when we release the story mode which makes a roster of 16 by then!

Story Mode under pre-development.

The story has been fully written and we have laid out the fights within the game, we would like to go fully cinematic and we're looking at mocap options to make this a reality as well as looking for lip syncing tools to match the characters voices when they talk.
although we're planning to go this route, things may change but it's looking likely we will go this way as technology and tools have progressed immensely in the past few years and will only get better allowing indies like us to produce better looking content that our players deserve.


Costume DLC confirmed!

This is also something we have kept secret for a long time for almost 2 years as modelling is very time consuming and expensive but we can finally announce that yes every character will be getting an alt costume through paid DLC.
when designing what these costumes should be we decided that instead of them being the same character wearing something different like most fighting game alts, we took it upon ourselves to make these alts entirely new characters! (they'll share the same moveset as the character it's an alt for)
Doing this will help expand the Terrordrome Universe as well as add more archetypes requested by you guys to the game without spending so much time and money making every character playable with their own moves.
We cannot confirm if these DLC costumes will be for purchase separately or released in a costume pack as we need to work with our publisher in order to get the best outcome.
Unfortunately we cannot share any images of them...yet, as not all of them have been modelled yet but please stay tuned for more updates on these characters as we could show one off in Cy8ernet1c?! flare.

notes.title: Terrordrome : Reign Of The Legends - Game Update 1.01
notes.notes:
So as I've mentioned within our Discord and within the Community Hub here on Steam with all major updates to the game there will always be issues that need to be addressed. 

Also bugs are always reported first on Discord so if you happen to post about an issue on the Community Hub there is a large chance I already know about it. So with that said if you want to be apart of the community join us on the Discord. 

Terrordrome Discord

Due to the change in our current license change with Unity, we are now force to display the splash screen. By the next update this will be removed.

So with that said here is the patch notes for Game Update 1.01

Note : Any issues that may cause your game to freeze, lock up or crash could be due to corrupted files, Please verify your files before reporting issues. As this could most likely be the fix to this problem.

 Bug Fixes 

[olist]
 Fixed an issue that was causing the HUD to be disabled when entering the Tutorial Mode.

 Fixed an issue that was causing the Start Button on keyboard to not work. It's now possible to open input config with only just the keyboard (ESC for P1) (Keypad Minus for P2).

Note : There is 4 types of Keyboards this being QWERTY, AZERTY, DVORAK and QWERTZ , I only have access to a QWERTY keyboard. So it's possible buttons that are listed within menu navigation will be wrong. Only way to fix this is to remap the button.

 Fixed an issue not allowing player 2's inputs to be configured within the settings menu.

 It's now possible to Replace the buttons that are assigned to the keyboard, but take note if a key your replacing is used on Player 2 this will need to be reassigned manually. Pads/FightSticks will continue to swap the inputs used.

 Fixed an issue with Opponent AI within training mode when set to a certain attack that would not reset to the next attack or have them stop attacking.

 Fixed an issue under certain circumstances that would cause an animation to be faster than it should be, this mainly effected Command Grabs.

[/olist]

 Arcade Ladder Fixes 

[olist]
 Fixed an issue not allowing Achievements to be unlocked after completing a character arcade ladder.

 Fixed an issue on varies character outros that didn't have text displaying.

 Mary's Outro now plays when you complete her arcade mode instead of her intro.
[/olist]

 Localization Fixes 

[olist]
 Japanese is now a support language within Arcade Ladder.

 Adjusted text to fix on screen for certain languages.

 Fixed an issue with Russian text being cut off within the main menu.

 Attempt to fix Russian text size in most Intro and Outros of Arcade Ladder.

 Attempt to fix default selected language when loading in to the main menu. If this is still happening a work around is by selecting your default language within Settings. 
[/olist]

 Character MoveSet Fixes 

[olist]
 Readded a missing animations from Frankenstein's Move Set that was causing certain soft locks. 

 Helsing can no longer be hit after confirming his Close Unleashed (Chupacabra Hug).

 Fixed an issue on invisible Man during his Close Unleashed (Say hello To my HUGE friend)

 Reduced the hit box size of Mr. Hyde's Air Punch, this fixes an unintended loop that lead to an infinite combo.

 Neverman can now perform his Jump Strong at any height within his jump arc.

 Fixed a Camera positioning issues with Wendigo's Close Unleashed (Cryogenic Slam) while near the stage wall.

[/olist]

notes.title: Terrordrome : Reign Of The Legends 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
We would like to first thank everyone that has been along for this whole dev cycle while we was in early access. 

Also note there is still new content coming to the game sometime next year this includes are full story mode and 3 new playable characters within a FREE UPDATE. We also have some paid DLC in the works in the form of additional costumes more on this very soon.

So with all that said here are the patch notes for this new version of the game, granted there maybe some things in the update that are not listed here.

 New Content 

1. Each character now has an Intro and Outro to the arcade ladder, Intros present the characters within your overall arcing story. While the Outros are a What If type scenario. When completing a characters arcade ladder you will now unlock an achievement for this character.

Note : More achievements will be added to the game in future updates 

 UI Changes/Fixes 

[olist]
  Audio settings are now fully synced with the settings that are within the main menu.

 Input Config is now split between players, players can now independently config buttons on Keyboard or Pad/FightStick. You can also config your inputs at the character selection screen while in local verse mode by pressing the Start Button. (Keyboard P1 : ESC | Keyboard P2 : Keypad -) 

[/olist]

 Overall Gameplay Fixes/Changes 

[olist]

 Now when put within a punished state your combo breaker is only locked for up to 10 seconds, this was a much needed change due to the nature of the combo system. Also while in a punished state your break meter won't rechange till the end of the 10 sec. Since doing this allows for more opportunities to bait your opponent in to doing a breaker that will likely be countered.

 Fixed unintended loops from jumping attacks, most air attacks have a reduced amount of hit stun.

 Fixed an issue where sometimes you may appear to be blocking a attack that's not even near you.

 Fixed issues where a combo breaker may not hit hit the opponent, all hit boxes for this move have been adjusted.

  On some characters to allow for a limited follow up the hit stun on certain combo strings is set up to be reduced on the next usage. For example Mary can now do P P K M Dash P P K M but can't do a second Dash. This allows for the follow up of P P K M Teleport to continue working.

[/olist] 

 Visual Changes 

[olist]
 A new filter is applied to the game to give certain effects more glow (Bloom) and changes to the overall brightness of the game. Due to this change UI within gameplay has to remain above the player characters.

 Updated shaders on character faces this allowed for better detail on characters overall look.

 Our UI now supports up to 8 more languages these are as follow : Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, French, Portuguese, German, Polish

 Better lighting with the character selection screen and VS screen, while also adding a P1 and P2 icon on the character selection cursor for better readability with brighter colors on the borders. 

 Fixed varies parts of stages that was blocking gameplay, and also adjusted certain cinematic cameras to be adjusted away from the stage wall.
[/olist]

New Content

[olist]

  invisible Man is now a playable character and selectable on character selection screen, here is his bio from the Web Site

A scientist and a well-equipped mercenary, Henry Griffin was plagued by his infatuation with cloak technology to better advance himself on the battlefield. His search for true invisibility resulted in him leaving the forces and perusing the rumors of special mediation techniques within the monks of the Tibetan mountains. Proving his theory of changing a physical object to be rendered invisible to the naked eye within a very specific frequency led his training to take a downturn finding himself tuning into a realm from beyond full of vicious creatures. Discovering a new world, Griffin took to researching it immediately traveling back and forth using leather clothing as protection noting down everything he can. Needing funding for this new project he took up a job as a mercenary for a vampiric CEO with his newfound powers despite the disapproval of his master.

 New Stage is now selectable named : Greenhouse this is the home stage for Invisible Man

 New Stage is now selectable named : Underground Lab this stage is the last selectable stage within the game and is mainly for story purposes. Here is the theme for this stage.

 Next content update will include character Arcade Intro and Outros that are current in process of being created. This will most likely be included in the first full release build after exiting Early Access.

[/olist]


Latest Improvements

[olist]

 Online mode has gotten a revamp to allow for better Initialization of our rollback netcode. This also allow for better set up of matches allowing all users in the lobby to select if they want to be player 1, player 2 or just spectate.

With this new lobby system there is now a chat window to allow for communication, this chat is set up to be PG so a strict filter is in place.

 Move sets are no longer preloaded when the game is launched reducing the memory overhead, as of this update we now load move sets from an asset bundle asynchronously allowing for faster loading times. This also helps any memory issues that previously was plaguing Steam Deck.

 Arcade mode has been reduced to only 8 total fights, 7 of which will be random from the whole roster.

 When on the final round while performing a combo if you get the opponents health below zero you will enter and OVERKILL state allowing your combo to continue. This gives you the opportunity to finish your opponent off with a Death Sentence. But due to certain limitations a re-stand or OTG isn't allowed during this state. So be mindful of the combo extensions you haven't used. 

 AI difficulty has been adjusted as we had found that in some cases changing the difficulty settings in the options really effect the AI opponents behavior.

 Various stage changes and fixes mainly to the collision box for keeping cameras from not going out of bounds during moves in the corner.

[/olist]

Character Fixes

[olist]

 Fixed an issue with all characters AI from not getting stuck in an endless loop of trying to dodge, this was due to the AI trying to dodge a projectile that was no longer on screen.

 Updates to all sounds for each character some issues with incorrect volume settings may still be present we're still looking in to these issues.

 Changes where made to the counter break animation this will appear as the opponent flashing red and performing a block animation. In most cases during a combo if performed successfully you'll see your character dodge the combo break allowing to continue your combo.

 Fixed an issue that would sometimes freeze the opponent after blocking certain moves while crouching.

 Fixed a lot of unintended loops for all characters.

 Sasquatch no longer has an EX version for his invisibility, previously this was meant to make him projectile Invulnerable but would make fully invulnerable from being hit.

 Cameras on certain moves have been adjusted in the corner allowing to show the action better and to not go out of bounds of the stage.

 Wendigo's Ice Spike move has been changed to a new move called : Summon Turn Pike This summons a spinning turning pike from the ground behind the opponent. If performed during a combo it will allow Wendigo to bounce the opponent back in to it. The Normal version allows for 3 hits while the EX version allows for 5 hits.

[/olist]

Greetings everyone and a happy warm welcome from the Terrordrome team.
we have been working hard the past few months continuing the develop Reign of the Legends as much as we can and we'd like to apologies for not creating a update for March.
The reason why we decided this was that we simply didn't have enough developed content enough to warrant a new update and as some are aware, some of us are still working full time jobs and it takes us away from developing the game quicker but now we have content to share with you today!

Wendigo has a brand new move!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/3d224abcf90938cd90c0a46b60db4cf9522d24bc.png

This move is the turnpike!
when making the Wendigo we added a move called ice spike where the creature summons a giant spike of ice out of the ground which lifts the opponent off the ground.
when trying it out we found along with our testers that the ice spike felt a little 1 dimensional and unfun when labbing and we knew we could do better and create something more fun.
This new move has Wendigo summon a bony turnpike from the ground, the amalgamation structure of bones will rotate for a period of time creating a long lasting hit box that can hit your foe until it despawns.
since the move had been given to our tester/Patreon build of the game we have already seen our testers preform unique and creative combos with the move including summoning the pike behind the opponent and launching them into it creating a new juggle combo as if they were like playing a game of tennis.

Post-Halloween Development Vlog

This month's update will be a bit short, but there will be more to share soon! Let's dive in!

Coding

Major Bug Fixes

With the recent update coming out later than anticipated, it allowed our lead coder Brad an opportunity to include more in the update. This included spectator mode, new blood effects, and more. Following the release of the recent major update, the team has been actively hunting for bugs this past month. This is a constant endeavor, as you know. It is a time-consuming, yet necessary step in our project's life cycle. Recently, we have found resolutions for hard freezes, improper animation placement, and online connectivity issues. Please report any bugs found in our discussion pages here on Steam or in our Discord.

Animations

Stage Polish

This month marks the beginning of future stage polishing. We have heard the criticism of our stages, and we couldn't agree more. They are in need of love. As you may have seen, the Cemetery Crossroads stage has received a revamp, and we plan to add more to existing stages. This topic is placed here as our lead animator Marc is taking time away from character animation to focus on stages. More details will be shared in following updates.

The first 2 of the 3 bonus fighters animations are complete as well. The final fighter has been modeled, however work on the final bonus fighter's animations has yet to start. More news on this topic will be covered in an upcoming vlog.

Other News

Project Scope

Recently, the team has made some significant decisions regarding the project's life cycle and road map due to increasing project scope and ambitions. The details of this will be further explained in our upcoming development vlog. 

Dev Vlog 7

Due to personal matters, some of our team had stepped away temporarily. This resulted in an unfortunate and unexpected delay in developing our newest vlog, which had been scheduled for October. The vlog is still underway, now with greater information and updates. We have very important news regarding the project scope, bonus fighters, teases, and more. So stay tuned!

We hope you had a great Halloween this year, as we certainly did. Reign of The Legends has received quite some recognition online, and we are happy to see it. We are continuing to expand and improve the game, taking into consideration the criticisms we receive. Thank you for supporting and following us!

- The TerrorTeam

Coding

Major Bug Fix

We was able to fix a major bug in the game that involved causing the frame rate to drop when pressing inputs. So be sure to look out for our next update and try it out if you previously had poor frame rate. Since this is now fixed, we are now cleared to move forward with our plans for the next update! We are always looking out for any bugs, so please feel free to submit any findings to the discussion thread or our discord server.

Characters

In our next development update, we will explore more of the Invisible Man's powers and gameplay. We believe that this fighter will be a trickster, capable of some deadly mix-up potential both visible and invisible. 

Final Three Fighters

notes.title: Terrordrome: Reign Of The Legends - Development Update: August 2023
notes.notes:
Jumping into the month of August!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/ae7b3836c4353c98c68af3bef74fef5be6865777.gif

This past month, we have been preparing for our next major update. We are also looking to release a small patch this week prior to the major update. Extra details below!


Coding

Memory Usage Improvements

One of the recent known issues with Reign of The Legends is an excessive amount of memory leakage and usage. This has been responsible for stuttering and poor performance on most machines. Our lead programmer Brad has been investigating the source of the memory leak, and he has found solutions to help reduce the amount of memory usage. There are still more steps to take to further improve this in the future as well. We will continue to combat against this and allow for a better experience in game. This may help those users who have been struggling to properly run the game. This will be present in the new patch later this week. 

Netcode Improvements

The team has been testing netcode performance, and we are excited to release improvements to our online experience. This includes better connections when connecting to opponents, a new user interface for invites, and a universal invite system for online that does not require linking an Epic Games Account. This will be featured in the new patch this week. 

Character Balance

In the coming patch, several characters have been looked at and will receive changes. Some notable examples include reworking existing special moves, removing unintended loops/infinites, adjusting hitboxes, and adding proper damage scaling to certain moves. More specific details will be available in the next patch's notes. This will be available later this week as well.

CPU AI
One of the bigger achievements in this coming update involves CPU artificial intelligence and difficulty. We have noticed some fighters do not perform to the expectation we have for them in certain difficulties. The team has improved upon and tested the CPU intelligence in recent weeks and have found greater results. Namely, higher difficulties will now feature more competent computer opponents. You can expect some more engaging combat from CPU opponents in the coming patch this week!

Animations

Final Three Fighters

With the Invisible Man's animations complete, animation work has been steadily focused on our final three members of the Roster. We are still holding off on the identities of these fighters for the time being, but we are approximately a little over halfway done with animations for these fighters. Other News

Epic Games Store

The team has officially confirmed that the Spring Heeled Jack update will mark the official release of Terrordrome: Reign of The Legends on The Epic Games Store! This is an exciting step for us to expand the game's reach and audience.

The Madman

The Team has looked into a new announcer for the game as stated in last months Development Vlog. We are happy to say we have found a new voice, and this new announcer will be featured in the Spring Heeled Jack update. We are dubbing this announcer "The Madman" as a nickname for the voice. We are looking to implement this new announcer very soon as all dialogue has been recorded.

EVO 2023: Indie Fighting Game Showcase

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/7fc905ac3cc8c223ae00748e0b48e871bea2e16e.png

As mentioned last month, Terrordrome: Reign of The Legends will be participating in EVO 2023's Indie Fighting Game Showcase. We will also be posting the trailer to our YouTube Channel as well!

With that all said, we greatly appreciate the continued support! We are working each day to have the game grow into a greater experience for our followers. Be on the lookout for these coming updates this month, and we will see you again in September! Thank you!

- The TerrorTeam

notes.title: Terrordrome: Reign Of The Legends - Development Update: May 2023
notes.notes:

We've got quite a bit to show off this month! A lot of work has gone into our next character, as well as fixes to the current public build. Let's get into it!

notes.title: Terrordrome: Reign of The Legends Development Update: April 2023

Characters

Three New Fighters

In our recent vlog, we confirmed that the final roster will now include 15 playable fighter. To clarify, these characters have already been decided. These fighters are also unrelated to the proposed DLC roster image that has been floating within our community. We would also like to state that these fighters are original characters that are directly involved with the game's story mode.

It has come to our attention that we have not been clear in regards to the games “planned” DLC that we made a few years back. We want to make it clear that the proposed DLC characters have never been guaranteed, both in proposed characters or if DLC will be made. The characters listed were initially a representation of what could make it to the game. These proposed characters were brought up during our Kickstarter campaign prior to 2018. In essence, if we were to produce DLC fighters, it has never been set in stone who could appear in game. Currently, our main goal is the completion of Terrordrome: Reign of The Legends on PC and to produce console ports. We do plan to continue to support the game with DLC fighters should the game's potential success warrant such support. Until then, we do not have any planned fighters for DLC. Apologies for any confusion and if we have disheartened you. 


Wendigo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/ca92d682adbe3e919505c4460dda809a02f8ddfc.gif

We truly believe he has been worth the wait. We are excited to reveal what this character is capable of in game upon completion. He has some unique properties to him aside from just his size. Currently we are balancing his move set, adjusting hit boxes, and adding sounds. 

For a teaser of this fighter, you can view our recent Vlog #5 video.

Stages

These past few months, we have shown off two of our new stages in development, the Winter Forest and The Realm of Agony. These stages are complete and are in a polishing phase. We are also still waiting for music tracks for these stages that we will share when available. Of course as we've mentioned before, these stages are planned to release along side the Wendigo. 

We have also began work on two new stages that we would like to share with you now! These stages have also been revealed in our vlog, but here are some extra details and updated screenshots.

The Greenhouse

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/c1747fc81fe64973054276a93d2788fc2ff04e55.png

Some might say that Dracula's Greenhouse is by far the most calming of locations within his estate. Though when seeking solitude inside, others say they can't shake the feeling they're not alone. Almost as if someone is watching them. There's definitely a certain aura that cannot be shaken when in the Greenhouse. The feeling that you're totally surrounded, and completely outnumbered. What horrors lie just beyond the surface can only be seen to believe. The Greenhouse will act as the home stage of the Invisible Man.

The Warehouse

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/ad7fff60bd29322e4cc4dca5bfab377b027866fa.png

It's no secret that the Vampires have significant control of the Earth. With such power and influence, what's stopping them from indulging on their greed and desires. Priceless riches from all across the globe, ancient artifacts from the most remote of locations, lost treasures from Atlantis to Camelot. With such wealth, it can be considered a goldmine for a potential thief. Internal reports indicate a prowler may be responsible for the misplacement of several prized possessions. The Warehouse will act as Spring Heeled Jack's home stage.

notes.title: Terrordrome: Reign Of The Legends Development Update: December 2022
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays from the Terror Team 

This year has been pretty big for us. 2 new stages and music tracks, Dracula in game, some important gameplay changes, being a part of Evo's indie game showcase, and much more. Admittedly, this past month has been a bit tough on the team as we have run into some unexpected setbacks. The team has run into issues while coding that must be resolved, and most of us have all fallen ill through the month. However, we still have some exciting things to show you this month!

Coding

Rollback Progress

Our coders Brad and Matt have put some time into our current netcode. We understand that this is an important element for any fighting game, and it is still a high priority. 
Without getting into the specific details, we are inching ever closer to having proper rollback implemented within the game. Currently, we have had some success with the progress yet still run into some de-synchronization within the connection. We believe we may have some solutions and we are looking to test them out soon. 

Input Recording

Recently, Brad has been able to find a solution to proper input recording. This allows for recording of frames in game that can then be played back by the player. A feature similar to this has already existed within our training mode, however this new method provides much more reliable results. This could also prove useful for allowing combo trials in the future and perfect input recording for practicing against certain techniques in training mode.

Characters

The Wendigo

The Wendigo's animations are just nearly complete. With almost all attack animations and reactions complete, we believe that the animations will be completed this month. Due to our aforementioned setbacks, this task has taken longer than expected as we have missed out on several days of work.

As a result, our coders have not yet began implementing this character into the game. Upon completion of all animations, the character can begin to be integrated into the game.

We were hoping to have this character ready before the new year, but it looks like we may not be able to reach that goal unfortunately. 

The team has also decided that the Wendigo will be a beastly creature, mostly consisting of screeches, shrieks, and screams. Yet, there will be some semblance of what sounds like spoken word. Is it possible there's something left of the person inside, or has the starving spirit fully taken over? Voice acting for this character has begun, and if you follow us closely, you may actually know the voice behind this monstrous giant.

The Invisible Man

One thing we can say about Invisible Man is that after completing the animations for Spring Heeled Jack, Invisible Man's animations should go much more smoothly as we have updated our animation files to only the necessary animations required per character. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37879004/d6e3bff7997875f9025f36fdddba3e09761d5159.png

Sadly, we do not have much else to share with you. Apologies for the delays in progress. We are still actively working on the project. We greatly appreciate all the support we continue to receive and we wish you all a happy holiday season. Until the new year!
- The TerrorTeam

 Gameplay System Changes 

[olist]

 A new meter has been added to the game, this meter is used to break out of your opponents combos with the new combo break. This meter fills passively, little when being hit, and a lot more when dodging attacks. Matches start with the meter being full.

 Air Recovery and Ground Recovery have been changed to a standard Combo break resetting characters to neutral. You can use this move on the first hit of an opponents combo, this move is disabled when hit during recovery frames of the attack you previously did, also known as a punish.

 Changes to the in game GUI, new break gauge is at the top near the timer, while the Unleashed and helper icons are at the bottom.

 Ground Recovery is now used as a Counter to Combo Break this can be triggered by using the Dodge button at the end of most combo string hits. If you predict correctly you can continue your combo, But if you fail this leaves you in a punishable situation.

 Most reactions on combo strings have been changed to allowed for better contact with the opponent.

 Certain moves now have more hit stop to make these moves feel more impactful. This also allows  better cancel timing for certain moves.

 Frankenstein 

[olist]

 His Standing Strong no longer knocks the opponent down instead it now does a stagger back. This move also no longer hits knocked down opponents.

 Both his Normal and EX version of Charged Shoulder now starts 4 frames faster. This gives him a better tool for getting in on the opponent, you can still cancel from this running change to the following moves :  Aftershock, Hammer Swing, EX versions of these moves and also Close Unleashed.

 The start of the normal Aftershock no longer hits a grounded opponent, this is still possible with the EX version.

[/olist]

 Sasquatch 

[olist]

 Sasquatch can once again cancel to his EX stomp from the second hit of his P M P combo string.

[/olist]

 Alex Van Helsing 

[olist]

 When using EX Kangaroo Kick (bomb version) the bomb is now blockable. This was previously unblockable.

 You can now cancel from Shotgun to Far Unleashed (Green Sun) by buffering the input.

[/olist]

 Neverman 

[olist]

 You can now cancel Crouch Strong in to this EX Teleport for a more stylish follow up within combos.

 Within the normal version of Suitcase Spikes you can buffer cancel to his Far Unleashed (void blast).

[/olist]


 Bloody Mary 

[olist]

 Mary now returns to the other side of the opponent faster within her normal ground teleport, this will allow more time to follow up within a combo.

 The clone within Mary's EX Teleport spawns closer to the opponent allowing for easier follow up within combos.

 Mirror Reflect can be buffer canceled to Far Unleashed (shard blast)

 Mary can now properly cancel her Air kick to air teleport.

[/olist]



 T .H .I. S 

[olist]

 Using Balloon Hatch after M M string is now a true combo extension, a dash cancel is no longer required.

 THIS can now buffer cancel from Spitting Ball to his Far Unleashed (Acid Shower), this allows for a nice OTG follow up.

[/olist]

 Mr. Hyde 

[olist]

  Fixed an issue within the animation timings of his command grab.

 Stand strong now causes a stagger back instead of a knockdown, there is a small window to follow up with another attack. This gives him a stand overhead combo starter.

  Hyde can now cancel directly to his Headbutt when preforming his Taunt Walk and the EX version. This move no longer knocks the opponent down and now hits overhead. The EX version can be canceled to Punch or Med for a new combo starter.

[/olist]

 The White Lady 

[olist]

 Medium attack travel distance reduced, this fixes an issue of her switching sides when juggling with M M S S string.

 EX Dive is now an overhead, this must be blocked standing.
